Restoring your smile

Dental implants

Explore a lasting replacement for a missing tooth.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

An implant replaces a tooth root and can support a replacement tooth. A consultation considers your mouth, health and available bone, alongside alternatives such as a bridge or denture. Treatment involves several stages and a period of healing.

What to expect

  1. Discuss your goals, dental health and alternatives.
  2. Arrange appropriate imaging and an individual treatment plan.
  3. Plan placement, healing and the final restoration with your clinician.

A common question

Is an implant suitable for everyone?

Suitability depends on an individual assessment. Ask about the full treatment plan, possible additional procedures, risks, maintenance and total cost.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
